note: Candidate draft produced by Agent 11, not by a Pidgin speaker. D-P1 notes that Nigerian Pidgin has no single agreed written standard, so a house style has to be chosen by a named reviewer rather than assumed by a drafter. Until that reviewer is named and recorded here, Pidgin is not offered.
